headline: Market-share Gains Take Priority

highlights: Key Points  2QFY27 sales grew 10.8% YoY / 10.9% QoQ to Rs1,541mn, the fastest in eight quarters and 7.6% above our estimates.
Growth was driven by higher promotional activity and traction in newer categories, including Tritonic drinkware and Deli stationery.
H1FY27 revenue grew 6.2% YoY.  EBITDA fell 27.8% YoY to Rs113mn, with margins declining by 393bps YoY to 7.3%, below our 8.5% estimate.

Excluding these impacts, core PAT stood at ~Rs64mn (down 23.9% YoY and up 6.2% QoQ), broadly in line with our estimates.  Premiumisation gaining traction: Pentonic grew 14.8% YoY, increasing its revenue share to 59.9% (vs. 55.1%), while mass own-brand sales declined 24.5%, indicating an improving product mix.
valuation: Licensed writing instruments (Uni-ball/Mitsubishi) grew 7.2%, while Deli-led other products grew 30.5%, supporting diversification beyond core pens.  We maintain BUY and cut our TP to Rs111 (from Rs116 earlier) and roll forward our valuation at 13.5x Sep-28E EPS.

Valuation: We raise FY27E/FY28E revenue ~2% each on the stronger topline trajectory, but cut FY27E EBITDA ~10% and FY28E by ~6% to build in the elevated promotion spend and slower margin normalization; we cut PAT by ~12%/~7%.
We roll forward to 13.5x Sep-28E EPS keeping the multiple unchanged, with a revised target price of Rs111 (from Rs116) and maintain our BUY rating.
